status: fixed before any Phase B inference
scope: development set only: the 50 P02 prompt-development ids. Further tuning on these records is not independent validation. Comparisons are P02 (primary), S1.0 (secondary).

evaluation_scope_fairness.primary_headline: strict micro F1 over all 18 canonical categories for P02, S1.0 and S1.1 alike. Removing current_conditions from model generation leaves canonical clinical_conditions as the schema's empty list; its gold entities then count as FN (same scope as P02).
reported_separately: micro F1 excluding clinical_conditions (all three systems)
micro F1 excluding clinical_conditions and clinical_uncertainties (all three systems)
clinical_conditions category row for all three systems
evaluation_scope_fairness.disclosure: S1.1 does not generate current_conditions; this is a change of the model task, not of the canonical schema or evaluator

failed_outputs: a record whose output is not parseable contributes no predictions (all gold counted FN) in every headline number; parsed-only subsets are post-hoc diagnostics, never headline

definitions.empty_collapse: parsed record whose chief_complaint is shorter than 4 characters or has no alphanumeric character, or whose 16 lists are all empty
definitions.repetition_loop: any list with >= 3 items identical in their primary field, or >= 3 items whose primary field is none/null/n-a/unknown/empty; OR the project parser flags degenerate repetition at the end of the output
definitions.category_collapse: a category where the arm has TP == 0 while P02 has TP >= 3 in that category (relative drops of >50% are listed as regressions, not collapses)
definitions.empty_field: blank primary field of an item (counted by validate_s11) or blank chief_complaint
definitions.missing_field: a required item field absent, or a required top-level key absent (validate_s11)

speaker_attribution: the canonical evaluator's speaker_attribution accuracy (unchanged); role flags from the adapter/sidecar are reported alongside: invalid_role, role_not_in_encounter, role_unavailable, role_missing
